description: Spin up an Ironbox: a secure sandbox next to Hyperliquid where an agent runs and trades, with Ironflow data, analytics, alerts and execution built in. No key needed for mode paper (the default): you get a trial box, the agent's own simulated Hyperliquid account for 24 hours, with base_url and expires_at. It ends sooner after 2 hours with no requests and no strategy running. Point the Hyperliquid SDK's base_url at it, or start a strategy on it with start_box_strategy. A free key keeps a box; mode live needs a paid plan. A live box stays creating until get_ironbox shows it running.
